list_available_scorers: list all available VizSeq scorers and their metric names
view_translation_examples: view translation examples with sources, references, hypotheses, and metric scores in an interactive notebook view
extract_n_grams: extract and visualize the top k n-grams from a text corpus in an interactive notebook view
compute_and_display_stats: compute and display sentence length statistics with histograms for source and reference texts
score_hypotheses: compute and display corpus-level and group-level metric scores for hypotheses against references
set_google_credentials: set the Google Cloud credential path for optional Google translation of source texts
